svg.title: A logistic population and its growth rate
svg.desc: Left: the population P against time t for the logistic model dP/dt = 0.0008P(1000 − P) with P(0) = 100. The curve starts at 100, rises slowly, then steeply, then levels off below the dashed line P = 1000, the carrying capacity. It is steepest where it crosses the dotted line P = 500, at about t = 2.75, where it changes from concave up to concave down. Right: the rate dP/dt graphed against P is a downward parabola, 0 at P = 0 and at P = 1000, with its largest value 200 at P = 500.

text.tspan: The population P against time t
The rate is 0 at P = 0 and P = 1000, largest at P = 500.
From P(0) = 100 the population rises toward 1000.
